name: print-social-red-happy-new-week-post-with-cutout-shape-and-photo
title: Photo of a designer in a patterned orange jacket with a rounded red card holding 'Happy New Week' and bullet points
whatItIs: A top-down desk photo of a person in a red patterned jacket and green cap drawing, with a red rounded panel at the bottom with a notch and 'Happy New Week. Clean slate. Strategy starts now.' plus three bullet points, an avatar with a brand name and a green 'Speak to us' pill, and a small logo and hashtag at the top.
whatItMeans: Warm and motivational; the red panel makes the greeting a promo card.
techniques: Overlay a notched red panel over a bottom of a photo.
Match the panel to the jacket.
Use a green pill for the CTA.
Add a small hashtag at the top.

vocabulary.definition: A panel with a cut-out corner.
A recurring post greeting the week.
